chapter: Trent's band: touring, sidemen and breakup
title: Playing with Ethel Waters in Little Rock
summary: While still in high school he and Swazey augment Ethel Waters's small band for two days, one of his first professional jobs.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: You know something that we didn't go over at your house, that I played with Ethel Waters.
No, we didn't go over that.
I had only been playing for a very short time, I was still in high school, and Ethel Waters came to Little Rock--
With that band, yeah. That must have been Fletcher's band then.
five guys with her. Was Johnny Dunn in that band?
Wasn't it Billy Kinsall or something like that?
I forgot the name of the band, but she didn't have enough--she wanted to augment it, so Swazey and I augmented the band.
You didn't go on the road?
No, we didn't go on the road. I was still in high school.
For how long did that last, a week or two?
She only stood there for two days.
So that was one of your first professional jobs?
One of my first professional jobs.
